changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Turns run on agent runs. A run may wait only so long for room once it is due (start_within_seconds), and its deadline bounds its current claim: it only moves earlier within a claim, and a requeue clears it. A queued run may move to another subject, as when two conversations merge.

rollback.stop: Restore the verified pre-upgrade database backup. The previous release reads a turn's lease from mentor_turn.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Each turn gets its run, keyed to its conversation. A turn that a host held keeps its claim and its lease, so the run reaper takes it back once the lease runs out, as any lost holder. An ended turn gets an ended run.
changeSet.sql: UPDATE mentor_turn SET run_id = gen_random_uuid(); INSERT INTO agent_run (id, workspace_id, kind, band, concurrency_key, state, attempt, lease_epoch, leased_until, available_at, start_within_seconds, stop_reason, created_at, started_at, ended_at) SELECT t.run_id, t.workspace_id, 'TURN', 'INTERACTIVE', 'conversation:' || t.conversation_id, CASE WHEN t.status = 'QUEUED' THEN 'QUEUED' WHEN t.status = 'RUNNING' OR (t.status = 'STOPPED' AND t.lease_id IS NOT NULL) THEN 'LEASED' ELSE 'ENDED' END, GREATEST(0, t.attempt - 1), t.attempt, CASE WHEN t.status = 'RUNNING' OR (t.status = 'STOPPED' AND t.lease_id IS NOT NULL) THEN COALESCE(t.leased_until, now()) END, t.queued_at, 180, CASE WHEN t.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') OR (t.status = 'STOPPED' AND t.lease_id IS NOT NULL) THEN NULL WHEN t.status = 'STOPPED' AND t.started_at IS NULL THEN 'CANCELLED' ELSE 'COMPLETED' END, t.created_at, CASE WHEN t.status = 'QUEUED' THEN NULL WHEN t.status = 'RUNNING' OR (t.status = 'STOPPED' AND t.lease_id IS NOT NULL) THEN COALESCE(t.started_at, now()) ELSE t.started_at END, CASE WHEN t.status IN ('QUEUED', 'RUNNING') OR (t.status = 'STOPPED' AND t.lease_id IS NOT NULL) THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(t.finished_at, now()) END FROM mentor_turn t; ALTER TABLE mentor_turn ALTER COLUMN run_id SET NOT NULL; ALTER TABLE mentor_turn ADD CONSTRAINT uk_mentor_turn_run UNIQUE (run_id, workspace_id); ALTER TABLE mentor_turn ADD CONSTRAINT sfk_mentor_turn_run FOREIGN KEY (run_id, workspace_id) REFERENCES agent_run (id, workspace_id);

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: The turn's run holds its lease; the turn keeps none of its own.

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A turn and its run agree when each transaction commits: queued with queued, running with leased, stopped with leased while its host may still end it or with ended, and an ended turn with an ended run.
changeSet.rollback: DROP TRIGGER agent_run_turn_agrees ON agent_run; DROP TRIGGER mentor_turn_run_agrees ON mentor_turn; DROP FUNCTION enforce_mentor_turn_run();

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: A turn's run goes with its turn, whoever deletes the turn: an erasure, a retention sweep, or a conversation's cascade. A run left without its turn would be offered to every claim, which could not start it.
changeSet.rollback: DROP TRIGGER mentor_turn_forgets_run ON mentor_turn; DROP FUNCTION forget_mentor_turn_run();

changeSet.author: hephaestus
changeSet.comment: Workers no longer beat in a registry: a run's lease is the only fact of a live holder.
